Name: Mizu's Phoenix
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Do you like mythical animals? Is the firebird of lore your favorite? This mod is for you if you like all things about phoenixes! It adds phoenixes as a new [b]coop [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Phoenixes love a good warm rock to nuzzle against and leave you a [b]fiery mineral[/b] every day.[/*]
[*]At high friendship, Phoenixes drop [b]Phoenix Down[/b] or [b]Cinder Shards[/b], or rarely they'll lay an egg! [/*]
[*](Optional) One cooking recipe to find from the [b]Island Trader.[/b][/*]
[*]Phoenix are a mythical mystery! You can find an egg occasionally in the entrance to the [b]Volcano Dungeon[/b], or you can find them from killing [b]Magma Sprites[/b] and [b]Magma Sparkers[/b].[/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore [/url]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the eggs to spawn around Ginger Island.[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops and drop a variety of items.

This recipe in this mod doesn't require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] to work. However, this mod does have compatibility with Animal Husbandry with the treats and butchering system. At the moment, phoenixes drop only an egg upon death. Future updates may try to include feathers as well.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] installed, causing some of the items to steam. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/b][/center]
By default the Red and Yellow appearances are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Sunrise Phoenix [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Sunrise Phoenix texture and adds it to the possible phoenix appearances.
[b]Enable Sunset Phoenix[/b] (false by default): Enables the Sunset Phoenix texture and adds it to the possible phoenix appearances.
[b]Enable Midday Phoenix [/b](false by default): Enables the Midday Phoenix texture and adds it to the possible phoenix appearances.
[b]Enable Midnight Phoenix [/b](false by default): Enables the Midnight Phoenix texture and adds it to the possible phoenix appearances.
[b]Enable Blue Phoenix [/b](false by default): Enables the Blue Phoenix texture and adds it to the possible phoenix appearances.
[b]Enable Balut[/b] (false by default): Enables the balut recipe. Sold by the Island Trader.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
